# Recovered upstream artefact

`dcat-us_3.0_shacl_shapes.recovered.ttl` is `shacl/dcat-us_3.0_shacl_shapes.ttl`
as it stood at commit `aaa3ff4a` in [GSA/dcat-us](https://github.com/GSA/dcat-us),
the last revision before PR #120 deleted it in commit `99ef81c9`.

It is reproduced here unmodified so the comparison in `reports/REPORT.md` can be
re-run without a git checkout:

    git show aaa3ff4a:shacl/dcat-us_3.0_shacl_shapes.ttl

3,435 lines, 34 `sh:NodeShape` declarations. Upstream is CC0 1.0, a work of the
United States Government.
